messages:
denise-support: heads up — BrightBank reported that after last night's v12 push their assistant stopped including short clarifying steps and safety notes. sample convo pasted below.

denise-support: CUSTOMER SAMPLE:
Customer: "How can I export April transactions to CSV?"
Assistant: "Open Reports and click CSV."
Customer: "Where are Reports?"
Assistant: "Settings > Reports."
Customer: "Can I filter by merchant?"
Assistant: "Use merchant filter."

denise-support: they said previously they got a 3-step list plus a note about file-size limits. now replies feel abrupt and missing caveats.

raj-eng-ml: can you share the request headers/metadata (model header, token counts, x-request-id)? also need the precise payload if possible.

denise-support: redacted request info:
```
POST /v1/generate
model: consensus-v12
prompt: <omitted>
prompt_tokens: ~18
response_tokens: ~42
x-request-id: rb-987654321
```

raj-eng-ml: v12 is the canary we promoted. initial guesses: a change in decoding defaults (max_new_tokens/stop sequences), or a new verbosity heuristic. will run A/B tests vs v11.

elaine-product: BrightBank is Dedicated but flows through hosted control plane for updates. can we confirm canary percentage timeline and any server-side prompt wrappers changed with v12?

deploy-bot: [deploy] consensus-v12 canary -> 18% @ 2026-03-16T02:13Z
mike-sre: 18% for 30m, 60% at 02:45, full at 03:20. no infra changes besides model binary.

denise-support: quick metric: BrightBank avg assistant tokens 24h before 03:00 UTC = 74; after full rollout 03:30-06:00 = 46. ~38% reduction.

raj-eng-ml: repro results:
- consensus-v11 avg reply: 68 tokens, included step list + caveat
- consensus-v12 avg reply: 44 tokens, terse responses
- tokenization same. root cause: v12 runtime config enabled a new "concise-mode" fallback which collapses certain intents into shorter outputs.

elaine-product: was concise-mode supposed to be on by default?

raj-eng-ml: no, it was intended as opt-in for specific tenants. however the runtime change in v12 flipped the default to enabled during promotion. this landed unintentionally.

denise-support: BrightBank escalated to their CSM — they count on the extra context for compliance reasons. they're asking for a fix.

mike-sre: I'll patch the runtime config to disable concise-mode default. no model rollback needed.

deploy-bot: [deploy] runtime-config patch applied -> concise-mode default: disabled @ 2026-03-16T07:12Z

denise-support: relayed to CSM; they did a quick smoke and see fuller replies again. customer prefers helpfulness despite cost.

elaine-product: action items: add account-level verbosity toggle (low/normal/verbose), add regression monitor for token medians per major customer post-deploy, and include this check in the canary gating.

raj-eng-ml: will add a unit in model onboarding to ensure concise-mode cannot be globally enabled without opt-in; will instrument canary monitors for median token delta per top-50 customers.

mike-sre: filing infra ticket: config promotion pipeline skipped opt-in gate. will include a postmortem.

denise-support: closing for now — customer satisfied with hotfix. will follow up with postmortem summary. :white_check_mark:
